acceptance_predicates.description: The easy sweep runs selected or all configured agents and workloads with bounded progress and cleanup.
The configured live provider is the default source and local mock or replay require explicit selection.
Every tuple preserves exact provider, model, agent, workload, and provenance identity.
Live, mock, and replay failures remain typed and never silently change mode.

definition_of_done: Exact reviewed selected/all sweep is merged on current ASB main.
Independent review and exact-head hosted checks pass with a privacy-safe receipt.

outputs.description: Bounded live, local, or replay sweep results with exact provenance.

gates.description: Selected/all tuple coverage and cleanup pass.
Results preserve exact source mode and identity.
